map.根据光源光通量、距离与展柜面积计算照度(lux)，并对照文物照度限值核查是否合规: Compute illuminance (lux) from source luminous flux, distance and showcase area, check compliance against artifact illuminance limits, and give adjustment advice if exceeded.
map.展柜布灯时，按灯具数量、光通量、利用系数与玻璃透过率估算总有效光通，用平均照度法: When lighting a showcase, estimate total effective luminous flux from lamp count, luminous flux, utilization factor and glass transmittance, and use the average illuminance method E = Φ/A to check whether exhibit illuminance limits are exceeded.
map.重点照明设计（射灯）时，用点光源中心照度 E=I/d² 与光斑直径评估打光效果，: When designing accent lighting (spotlights), use point source center illuminance E = I/d² and spot diameter to evaluate the lighting effect, avoiding local overexposure or too small a spot.
map.等级敏感展品（书画/丝绸高敏感）布光时，对照 GB/T 23863-2009 限: When lighting grade-sensitive exhibits (calligraphy and silk are highly sensitive), check against GB/T 23863-2009 limits (highly sensitive 50 lx, low/medium sensitivity 150 lx, insensitive 300 lx) and dim or add filters if needed.
map.：某展柜 4 盏 LED（单盏 500 lm、光束角 36°、利用系数 0.7）: : a showcase with 4 LEDs (500 lm each, beam angle 36°, utilization factor 0.7), glass transmittance 100%, area 10 m², 2 m from the exhibit, highly sensitive (limit 50 lx). Total effective luminous flux = 4 × 500 × 0.7 × 1.0 = 1400 lm; average illuminance = 1400 ÷ 10 = 140 lx; solid angle = 2π(1 − cos18°) ≈ 0.307 sr, single lamp intensity ≈ 350 ÷ 0.307 ≈ 1138 cd, center illuminance ≈ 1138 ÷ 4 × 4 ≈ 1138 lx; spot diameter = 2 × 2 × tan18° ≈ 1.30 m. Conclusion: the 140 lx average far exceeds the 50 lx limit for high sensitivity, so dimming is required (lower lumen source / dimming / filters).
map.依据 GB/T 23863-2009《博物馆照明设计规范》：高敏感展品（书画、丝: Per GB/T 23863-2009 'Code for lighting design of museum': highly sensitive exhibits (calligraphy, silk and similar) at most 50 lx with annual exposure at most 150,000 lx·h; low/medium sensitivity at most 150 lx; insensitive at most 300 lx. Lighting must match exhibit sensitivity.
map.平均照度与中心照度为何差很多？: Why do average and center illuminance differ so much?
map.平均照度 E=总光通÷面积反映整体亮度；中心照度 E=I/d² 反映射灯光斑中心: Average illuminance E = total luminous flux ÷ area reflects overall brightness; center illuminance E = I/d² reflects the spot center peak of a spotlight (point source falls with the square of distance). The spot center is often far above the average, so accent lighting must control both to avoid local overexposure damaging artifacts.
